# infisical_secret_sync_spacelift (Resource)

Create and manage Spacelift secret syncs

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    infisical = {
      # version = <latest version>
      source = "infisical/infisical"
    }
  }
}

provider "infisical" {
  host = "https://app.infisical.com" # Only required if using self hosted instance of Infisical, default is https://app.infisical.com
  auth = {
    universal = {
      client_id     = "<machine-identity-client-id>"
      client_secret = "<machine-identity-client-secret>"
    }
  }
}

resource "infisical_secret_sync_spacelift" "example" {
  name          = "spacelift-secret-sync"
  description   = "Sync secrets to a Spacelift context"
  project_id    = "<your-infisical-project-id>"
  connection_id = "<app-connection-id>" # The ID of your Spacelift App Connection
  environment   = "<env-slug>"
  secret_path   = "<infisical-secret-path>"

  auto_sync_enabled = true

  destination_config = {
    context_id   = "<spacelift-context-id>"
    context_name = "<spacelift-context-name>"
    config_type  = "environment-variable"
  }

  sync_options = {
    disable_secret_deletion = false
    key_schema              = "{{secretKey}}-{{environment}}"
    write_only              = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `connection_id` (String) The ID of the spacelift Connection to use for syncing.
- `destination_config` (Attributes) The destination configuration for the secret sync. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination_config))
- `environment` (String) The slug of the project environment to sync secrets from.
- `name` (String) The name of the Spacelift sync to create. Must be slug-friendly.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Infisical project to create the sync in.
- `secret_path` (String) The folder path to sync secrets from.
- `sync_options` (Attributes) Parameters to modify how secrets are synced. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sync_options))

### Optional

- `auto_sync_enabled` (Boolean) Whether secrets should be automatically synced when changes occur at the source location or not.
- `description` (String) An optional description for the Spacelift sync.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the Spacelift secret sync

<a id="nestedatt--destination_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `destination_config`

Required:

- `config_type` (String) The type of config element to create in Spacelift. Supported options: environment-variable, file-mount
- `context_id` (String) The ID of the Spacelift context to sync secrets to.
- `context_name` (String) The name of the Spacelift context to sync secrets to.

Optional:

- `file_mount_format` (String) The format for file mount config elements. Supported options: dot-env (default), secret-per-file
- `mount_path` (String) The file path for the mounted file relative to /mnt/workspace/. Required when config_type is 'file-mount' and file_mount_format is not 'secret-per-file'. When file_mount_format is 'secret-per-file', this is the directory path.


<a id="nestedatt--sync_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sync_options`

Optional:

- `disable_secret_deletion` (Boolean) When set to true, Infisical will not remove secrets from Spacelift. Enable this option if you intend to manage some secrets manually outside of Infisical.
- `include_all_sub_folders` (Boolean) Whether to sync secrets from folders beneath the source path as well.
- `key_schema` (String) The format to use for structuring secret keys in the Spacelift destination.
- `write_only` (Boolean) Whether secrets should be marked as secret in Spacelift. Secret values are only available to Runs and Tasks and are not accessible in the web GUI or through the API.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# This will import the Spacelift secret sync by its ID
terraform import infisical_secret_sync_spacelift.example <secret_sync_id>
```
